DRAFT OPTIONS (each is an alternative route; none is chosen yet; any legal/financial step would go to a qualified professional)
O1. Facts-first pause: all three receive the same written will/estate facts, independent valuation, and timing; each gets private time and optional independent advice; A’s housing stability and family connection stay visible, with no change imposed by this conversation; B receives information directly, when available, to plan; C is asked to sign nothing and subsidize nothing; no price/terms discussion until all say they are ready.
O2. Parallel paths, no assumed discount: after the facts, examine several paths side by side—A’s feasible purchase at an independently established value with financing limits clear, a temporary hold, an open-market sale, or any sister’s proposal—with the house’s family connection considered, no deadlines or pressure, and no one speaking for another. A family discount is not assumed; if ever raised, it is only a freely declineable request, never an expectation. B speaks for herself about possible funds; C’s fair share and free yes are explicit.
